page.title: Legal Information
page.subtitle: This document sets out the legal and regulatory framework of the SendMe project. It has been written in a spirit of transparency and professionalism, as part of a final year project (TFE) intended for educational and demonstration purposes.
page.noResultsSub: Try modifying your search or selecting another category.

content.subtitle: Project context
content.text: SendMe is a web-based money transfer application developed as part of a Final Year Project (TFE). It is a technical demonstration and a functional prototype: SendMe is neither a commercial service, a payment institution nor a financial institution.

content.subtitle: About the project
content.text: The project was designed and built by a student as part of their final year studies. It covers the full-stack architecture (React frontend, Java & Spring Boot API, database), the security and the business features of a money transfer platform.

content.subtitle: Demonstration nature
content.text: The accounts, amounts and transactions shown are fictitious test data. No real financial operation is carried out by the platform.

content.subtitle: Hosting
content.text: The application is deployed on a demonstration environment for educational purposes only. No real payment is processed.

content.subtitle: Contact
content.text: For any question about the project: ib2diallo@gmail.com

content.subtitle: Educational objective
content.text: To reflect the requirements of the payment services industry, the prototype integrates mechanisms inspired by the regulations: the European directive on payment services (PSD2), the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and anti-money laundering (AML). These elements are implemented for educational and illustration purposes.

content.subtitle: Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)
content.text: The demonstration transactions simulate Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), in line with good practices inspired by PSD2: verification by SMS code, email or authentication application.

content.subtitle: Limitations
content.text: This implementation confers no regulatory status on the application. SendMe is not licensed and does not provide real financial services.

content.subtitle: General framework
content.text: Internet law refers to the set of rules applying to networks and online services: freedom of information, consumer protection, data processing and the liability of web actors. These rules are rooted in Belgian and European law.

content.subtitle: Users' rights
content.text: Any user of an online service must be clearly and prior informed of the terms of use and of the fate of their data. They may access the service, be informed of their rights and enforce them in case of a dispute.

content.subtitle: Data controller
content.text: Within the scope of the TFE, the project owner acts as the data controller of personal data, for the sole purpose of the academic demonstration.

content.subtitle: Data collected
content.text: The data processed is limited to what is required for the demonstration: email address and name for the test account, fictitious beneficiaries and entered amounts. Simulated transactions only involve fictitious data.

content.subtitle: Legal basis
content.text: Processing is based on consent and on the educational purpose of the project, in accordance with GDPR requirements.

content.subtitle: Retention period
content.text: Data is kept for the duration of the demonstration and the evaluation of the project, then deleted.

content.subtitle: Your rights
content.text: Under the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability of your personal data.

content.subtitle: How to exercise them
content.text: To exercise these rights, please send a written request to: ib2diallo@gmail.com. We undertake to respond as soon as possible.

content.subtitle: Right to be forgotten
content.text: You may ask at any time for the deletion of your personal data. At the end of the project and its evaluation, the demonstration data is permanently erased.

content.subtitle: Complementary framework
content.text: Data processing falls within the scope of the GDPR, the Convention 108 of the Council of Europe and the Belgian law on the protection of privacy.

content.subtitle: Use of cookies
content.text: The demonstration uses only the cookies and local storage strictly necessary for the application to work: authentication session, language and theme preferences.

content.subtitle: No tracking
content.text: No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used on the application.

content.subtitle: Management
content.text: You can configure your browser to block or delete these cookies. Some features might then no longer be available.

sections.title: Terms of Use of the Demonstration

content.subtitle: Purpose
content.text: These terms govern the use of the SendMe platform within the framework of its academic demonstration (TFE).

content.subtitle: Access
content.text: Access to the application is provided as a technical demonstration. No real financial transaction is executed.

content.subtitle: Liability
content.text: The project is provided as is, for educational purposes, without warranty of any kind. It must not be used for commercial purposes or interpreted as a real financial service.

content.subtitle: Simulator
content.text: The fees and exchange rate simulator presents fictitious indicative data intended to illustrate the user experience.

content.subtitle: No real rates
content.text: The displayed rates and fees do not reflect any real financial market and cannot be used for a real operation.

content.subtitle: Website content
content.text: The structure of the website, its texts, visuals and logo are protected by copyright. They were produced within the scope of the TFE and may not be reproduced without the prior consent of the author.

content.subtitle: Operator logos
content.text: The Mobile Money operator and institution logos shown on the site belong to their respective owners. They are used here solely for demonstration purposes and to recognise the channels.

content.subtitle: Educational use
content.text: As the project is carried out in an academic context, any reproduction, distribution or exploitation of the site's elements is subject to copyright and intellectual property rules.

content.subtitle: Framework
content.text: E-commerce is subject to rules aimed at protecting consumers: pre-contractual information, order confirmation, secure payment and withdrawal rights.

content.subtitle: Application to the project
content.text: As SendMe is a demonstration, no real sale takes place. The payment flow uses Stripe in test mode with fictitious cards, in order to illustrate the best practices of an online merchant site.

content.subtitle: Customer information
content.text: Fees and exchange rates are shown before a transfer is confirmed, in line with the transparency expected from an online payment service.

sections.title: Liability Relating to the Dissemination of Information

content.subtitle: Dissemination of information
content.text: The dissemination of information online engages the liability of its author. Published content must be lawful, must not harm the rights of third parties and must comply with applicable law.

content.subtitle: Demonstration content
content.text: The information presented on the platform (operation, fees, rates) is fictitious and provided for illustration only. It does not engage the author's liability outside the educational framework.

content.subtitle: Limitation
content.text: In the absence of a real commercial service, no contractual or non-contractual liability can be engaged as a result of using the demonstration.

content.subtitle: Hosts and intermediaries
content.text: Under Belgian law, the liability of hosts and intermediate providers is regulated: they are generally not liable for the content they host as long as they are not aware of it.

content.subtitle: Application
content.text: As the site is hosted on a demonstration environment, the rules on intermediate providers apply as a reference. In case of a reported content, we ensure its removal as soon as possible.

content.subtitle: Secure communications
content.text: Communications are encrypted (HTTPS/TLS). Passwords are hashed and authentication sessions are secured.

content.subtitle: Fictitious data
content.text: No real banking data is processed. The payment module is used in test mode with demonstration credentials.

content.subtitle: Good practices
content.text: The project applies good web security practices: input validation, route protection and secure management of authentication tokens.

content.subtitle: Objective
content.text: To illustrate industry requirements, the prototype simulates Know Your Customer (KYC) and suspicious activity detection mechanisms.

content.subtitle: Simulation
content.text: These mechanisms are purely demonstrative. They do not correspond to any real regulatory obligation and the application is not subject to anti-money laundering regulations.

content.subtitle: Limitation
content.text: No suspicious transaction report is actually filed by the platform.

content.subtitle: Feedback on the project
content.text: For any question, remark or feedback about the final year project, you can contact the project owner at: ib2diallo@gmail.com

content.subtitle: Acknowledgements
content.text: As this project was carried out in an academic context, we thank you for your visit and your understanding of the demonstration nature of the application.

footer.disclaimer: This website is a final year project (TFE) built for educational and demonstration purposes. SendMe is a prototype: it is not a commercial service, a payment institution or a financial institution. The regulatory references and data presented are fictitious and have no contractual value.
